comparison.objective: Lay three floorboards tightly together while leaving a 10–20 mm expansion gap at each wall.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar placement, edge mating, and gap control, not precision tool impact or debris retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Three boards are tight together and both wall gaps are within 10–20 mm; other tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Board layout and measured clearance do not test fracture, retained-insert protection, or free-fragment containment.
